title: UEFA CEDB  - 24.04.2026
text:
CONTROL, ETHICS AND DISCIPLINARY BODY  

Decisions of 24 April 2026

 
 
 
 
 CEDB – 24 April 2026 

Dear Sir or Madam, 

Please see below the main elements of the decision taken by the UEFA Control, Ethics and Disciplinary 

Body (CEDB) on 24 April 2026.  

If, following a request by the party concerned, a decision with grounds is issued, that full decision will be 

made available in the case law section of this website after it becomes final and binding. 

To navigate this document, you can click on the name of a case in the contents to jump to that particular 

sanction and click on the header at the top of any page to return to the contents.  

We trust this document will be of interest.  

Yours faithfully, 

UEFA 

Angelo Rigopoulos  
Executive Director of Integrity & Regulatory  

William McAuliffe 
Head of Disciplinary

UEFA Champions League 2025/2026 

SL Benfica vs. Real Madrid C.F. (0:1); 17 February 2026 

SL Benfica 

Incident and sanction: 

•  Discriminatory (i.e. homophobic) conduct (Mr. Gianluca Prestianni Gross), Article 14 DR 

  Suspension: six (6) UEFA club and/or representative national team official matches. The suspension 

for three (3) of these matches is subject to a probationary period of two (2) years
